description: Morrow's versioned BillingTerms@1 revisions per environment (P01.T04a R10; ADR-0022 item 11: US$49 a month with 300 credits; M5 PR-1). Each revision carries its display offers (the price a subscription entry charges, in minor units, per month) and the published digest: SHA-256 of the canonical JSON of {terms, offers}. A published revision never changes; a new price, credit quantity or offer is the next revision. staging:seed-platform writes an environment's revisions, in order, to morrow_billing.billing_terms and refuses on drift; npm run verify:billing checks this file. development is a synthetic fixture for labs and the fake Stripe origin. staging's revision 1 (ADR-0022 item 5 amendment, owner decision (b), 2026-10-21) carries only the operator test entitlement's entry: the beta plan's 300 test credits with no provider price and no offer, read only by the owner's operator path (staging:test-entitlement, card E13); staging's first priced revision follows the owner's test-mode Product and Price (owner action 2 of docs/briefs/M5-billing.md) when the Stripe switch is turned on, and until then staging checkout fails closed. production has none until M6.
